contracts.forbidden_condition: Dispatch of a store Op whose namespace has fewer than 2 segments, whose namespace[1] is not a positive-integer user_id string, or of a ListNamespacesOp (cross-tenant enumeration deemed unsafe), to an underlying per-tenant PostgresStore.

contracts.protected_resource: Per-user Postgres schemas mem_u{user_id}_v{version} (store / store_vectors) behind TenantRoutingStore, the only BaseStore handed to LangGraph.
contracts.protection_obligation: Every LangGraph store operation routed through TenantRoutingStore must carry a well-formed per-tenant namespace (namespace[1] = positive-integer user_id), and cross-tenant namespace listing (ListNamespacesOp) must be rejected outright.
scope_limits: Validation is shape-only: _resolve_user_id accepts any positive integer uid and does not compare namespace[1] with the authenticated caller; tenant isolation therefore depends on callers deriving namespace[1] from the logged-in user (tenant_store.py:4-6, 374-393).
DualWriteStore (migration path) adds no namespace validation of its own; it only receives sub-ops already validated by TenantRoutingStore (tenant_store.py:290-337, 434-437).
